baseline_models.focus_anchor: The exclusive opening, the ordered titles, and the closing rejection of what they associate enclose the ayah as one construction.
baseline_models.mechanism: Exclusive worship establishes one center; sovereignty, purification, peace, security, supervision, strength, repair or compulsion, and rightful greatness then operate as an indivisible governing system. The final partnership clause denies that any function in this system can be detached and assigned to a rival source.

activation_trace.role: Worship and the worshipped supply the ayah's exclusive center and make the following powers answer to one object of devotion.
Kingship and sovereignty supply the governing capacity from which the subsequent functions proceed.
Purity and removal from contamination make governance corrective rather than merely possessive.
Reconciliation opposed to war supplies the social settlement produced by the governing sequence.
Security, trust, and entrusted reliability turn settlement into a condition in which hearts can rest.
Witnessing and sustained care supply the supervision that preserves the secured order.
Strength and inviolability supply the capacity that prevents the order from being overthrown.
Mending fracture and deficiency supplies a restorative use for irresistible power.
Rightful grandeur supplies the scale proper to the sole center rather than to a competing claimant.
Shared participation supplies the closing counter-model: partitioned control opposed to indivisible rule.

changed_reading.before: A list of independent honorifics followed by a general denial of partners.
changed_reading.after: A single governance-and-repair architecture whose peace, security, force, and grandeur cannot be partitioned among rival powers.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: Al-Jabbar follows peace, security, supervision, and strength rather than standing alone.
baseline_models.mechanism: The sequence keeps both live branches of j-b-r. Compulsion remains real, but its placement after defect-free safety, trusted security, watchful care, and cohesion makes the force intelligible as force capable of setting fractures rather than arbitrary domination.

activation_trace.role: Freedom from defect supplies the intact condition toward which the sequence moves.
Restful security supplies the human effect that distinguishes repair from mere subjugation.
Ongoing guardianship supplies the care under which force operates.
Hard cohesion supplies the integrity that resists renewed fracture.
Mending a break or deficiency supplies the reparative pole of al-Jabbar.
Compulsion and overpowering supply the dangerous but still live pole that makes the repair irresistible.

changed_reading.after: Al-Jabbar holds coercion and fracture-mending together, with the preceding security titles orienting force toward restored integrity without erasing its severity.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: Al-Quddus, Subhan Allah, and the final yushrikun form a purity-versus-admixture axis inside the focus ayah.
baseline_models.mechanism: Purification near the start and active exoneration near the end make the rejection of association more than numerical monotheism. The ayah removes every contaminating mixture by which creaturely partnership would qualify the titles between them.

activation_trace.role: Purification and exoneration supply the opening removal of contamination from the title sequence.
Exonerating and distancing from defect supplies the explicit closing act of purification.
Mixture through shared participation supplies the contamination that the two purification terms reject.
Making a partner for God fixes the theological target of the broader participation image.

changed_reading.before: Purity, praise, and anti-association are separate devotional claims.
changed_reading.after: They form one decontamination mechanism that protects every intervening title from creaturely admixture or delegated rivalry.

context_deltas.mechanism: The surah places the same might-and-wisdom pair at both outer edges. This frame revises al-Aziz and the coercive branch of al-Jabbar in the focus: irresistible capacity is repeatedly coupled to apt judgment and exact construction, so severity is not semantically free-standing.

activation_trace.role: Strength and inviolability supply the first half of the repeated outer-frame pair.
Rightly directed wisdom supplies the governing qualification paired with might at the opening.
Repeated strength closes the frame and reconnects the focus's al-Aziz to the same qualification.
Exactness and well-made firmness make the closing wisdom materially constrain how strength is imagined.
The focus's compulsion branch is the force whose apparent openness is narrowed by the repeated wisdom frame.

structural_cues: 59:1 and 59:24 repeat al-Aziz/al-Hakim around the narrative and around the focus title sequence.
The focus repeats al-Aziz but expands the middle with security, guardianship, repair, and grandeur.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies the repeated might/wisdom pair and the focus's coercion branch; I infer that the frame governs the direction of force toward apt judgment. A live alternative is that the repetition only marks doxological closure without qualifying each inner title.

changed_reading.before: Al-Aziz and al-Jabbar can sound like unqualified maximal force.
changed_reading.after: Their force is framed twice by wisdom and exactness, making power controlled, purposive, and fitted to its object.

context_deltas.mechanism: Two context scenes reverse outside and inside: enclosing fortresses seem to guarantee safety while fear occupies hearts, and a group seems gathered behind walls while its hearts are scattered. Al-Mu'min and al-Muhaymin therefore shift from generic protection to security and supervision capable of reaching the interior coherence that architecture and coalition cannot produce.

activation_trace.role: Preservation inside an enclosing fortress supplies the failed external model of security.
The heart supplies the interior site at which the supposed protection is reversed.
Fear and panic supply the inward failure concealed by outward fortification.
Gathering dispersed parts supplies the twice-stated appearance of collective unity.
A second enclosing fortification repeats the external-security model.
The raised wall gives the external boundary behind which apparent unity shelters.
Hearts again locate the decisive condition inside the enclosure.
Dispersion supplies the actual inner state that overturns the visual impression of gathering.
Security and settled trust supply the focus's alternative to brittle enclosure.
Watchful care supplies supervision that crosses the wall and reaches the concealed interior.

structural_cues: 59:2 moves from presumed fortress protection to fear in hearts.
59:14 repeats 'all together' but immediately opposes it with scattered hearts behind fortifications and walls.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies enclosing defenses, outward gathering, and inward fear or dispersion; I infer that the focus titles answer the repeated outside/inside failure by locating true security in integrated interiors. A live alternative is that the scenes demonstrate defeat without defining al-Mu'min or al-Muhaymin.

changed_reading.before: Divine security is a stronger version of ordinary external protection.
changed_reading.after: Divine security differs in kind: it reaches hearts and coherence, where walls and visible alliances can conceal rather than cure collapse.

context_deltas.mechanism: The paired acts of severing and leaving upright on roots occur under one permission. This makes al-Malik and al-Jabbar a discriminating authority that can interrupt one structure and preserve another; irresistible rule is not reducible to indiscriminate destruction.

activation_trace.role: Severing and separation supply one authorized mode of intervention.
Leaving a thing in its condition supplies the opposed mode of deliberate non-severing.
Bodily uprightness supplies the preserved vertical condition of what is left.
Root and base supply the continuing support on which preserved life remains standing.
Permission supplies the common authorization governing both opposite acts.
Possession and discretion anchor the opposed interventions in the focus's sovereign title.
Compelling force is revised by the context's evidence that force can authorize restraint as well as cutting.

structural_cues: The verse coordinates 'you cut' and 'you left it standing on its roots' as alternatives under one permission.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies the cut/leave opposition, rooted standing, and common authorization; I infer a general pattern of calibrated sovereignty that qualifies the focus's force titles. A live alternative is that the authorization is local to this event and should not control the title sequence.

changed_reading.before: Sovereign compulsion acts principally by breaking resistance.
changed_reading.after: Sovereign compulsion includes judgment over when to sever and when to preserve a rooted structure intact.

context_deltas.mechanism: Returned wealth is redirected so that it does not remain a closed turn among the rich; the sequence then names poverty, preference for others amid one's own lack, protection from withholding, and removal of concealed rancor. This operationalizes al-Malik, al-Salam, al-Mu'min, and the reparative al-Jabbar as material circulation that mends both shortage and the inward residues of unequal possession.

activation_trace.role: Return and reversion supply the movement by which captured resources come back for reassignment.
Transfer between hands and conditions supplies the circulation that must not close among the wealthy.
Need and scarcity supply the material fracture toward which redistribution is directed.
Choosing another over oneself supplies the counter-motion to exclusive accumulation.
A gap or breach in one's condition makes generosity operate from within real lack rather than surplus.
Withholding joined to greedy concern supplies the inward blockage that must be guarded against.
A grudge concealed in the breast supplies the social residue that material redistribution alone does not remove.
Disposition over property anchors the redistribution mechanism in al-Malik.
Reconciliation supplies the social condition sought after rivalry and concealed rancor are cleared.
Repairing want and deficiency supplies the focus title's direct material-social function.

structural_cues: 59:7 states the anti-concentration purpose, and 59:8-10 progresses from displaced poverty to self-preference, withholding, and hidden rancor.
The sequence repairs both distribution between hands and disposition within hearts.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies return, circulation, scarcity, other-preference, withholding, and concealed resentment; I infer that their ordered movement is a concrete enactment of sovereign repair and peace. A live alternative is to keep the distribution rule legally discrete from the divine titles.

changed_reading.before: Kingship, peace, and repair are abstract properties of supreme rule.
changed_reading.after: They become a redistributive mechanism: authority reopens blocked circulation, fills social breaches, and treats the rancor that unequal possession leaves behind.

context_deltas.mechanism: Promised solidarity is exposed by knowledgeable witness as false, turns its back under pressure, and culminates in explicit disavowal. Against this sequence, al-Mu'min reads as the reliable confirmer and giver of security, al-Muhaymin as the witness who can underwrite that guarantee, and the final rejection of partnership as a warning against protection contracts whose partners abandon one another.

activation_trace.role: Testimony grounded in knowledge supplies the exposure of the promised alliance.
Contradiction of truth supplies the defect in the alliance's verbal guarantee.
Turning away supplies the enacted reversal of promised nearness and support.
Presenting the back and withdrawing makes abandonment spatially visible.
Disavowal and separation supply the endpoint of the false partner's guarantee.
Confirmation that settles the heart supplies the reliable promise contrasted with lying assurances.
Witnessing and entrusted care supply the guarantor who knows whether speech and action coincide.
Partnership supplies the contractual structure whose creaturely form the context reveals as unreliable.

structural_cues: 59:11-12 opposes emphatic promises of accompanying and helping with non-accompaniment, non-help, and retreat.
59:16 repeats the promise-abandonment pattern as inducement followed by disavowal.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies false assurance, informed witness, retreat, and disavowal; I infer that these failures sharpen the focus's security and witness titles into a non-abandoning guarantee. A live alternative is that the contrast targets hypocrisy alone and does not extend to the semantics of divine security.

changed_reading.before: Al-Mu'min gives safety and al-Muhaymin observes.
changed_reading.after: Together they name security as a witnessed, truth-bearing guarantee that does not turn its back when dependence becomes costly.

context_deltas.mechanism: The knowing guardian's oversight is answered by an imperative that each self inspect what its intentional acts have sent forward into tomorrow. Al-Muhaymin therefore becomes more than unilateral surveillance: divine interior knowledge generates a human feedback practice of prospective self-audit.

activation_trace.role: Directing sight or insight toward an object supplies the act of self-examination.
Advancing something forward supplies the temporal effect of present action.
The next day supplies the future horizon into which action is projected.
Knowledge of the report and inward reality supplies the divine side of the audit.
Intentional action supplies the auditable material rather than mere appearance.
Witnessing and care anchor the two-sided audit mechanism in al-Muhaymin.

structural_cues: 59:18 places the self's imperative to look before the statement that God knows inwardly what people do.
The verse joins present intentional action to a future 'tomorrow.'
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies self-looking, forward projection, tomorrow, intentional work, and divine inward knowledge; I infer a feedback loop in which divine oversight elicits human oversight. A live alternative is a simple command/accountability relation without reciprocal structure.

changed_reading.before: Al-Muhaymin is a watcher positioned entirely above the observed.
changed_reading.after: Al-Muhaymin's knowing care activates prospective self-observation, turning oversight into a lived discipline across present and future.

context_deltas.mechanism: Forgetting the sole divine center recursively produces forgetting one's own self. The exclusive 'no deity but He' and the security-care sequence can therefore be read as identity-preserving orientation: relation to the one center keeps the self available to itself, while abandoned remembrance disorganizes self-recognition.

activation_trace.role: Loss of remembrance supplies both the initiating failure and its recursively imposed consequence.
The thing's own identity or self supplies what becomes inaccessible when the orienting center is forgotten.
The sole object of worship anchors the remembered center on which the identity reading depends.
Settled security supplies the coherence preserved by orientation to that center.

structural_cues: 59:19 repeats the forgetting verb while reversing the object from God to their own selves.
The focus repeats the exclusive deictic center 'He' around the denial of any other deity.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies an explicit forgetting-to-self-forgetting sequence and an exclusive divine center; I infer an identity-preserving relation between remembrance and inward security. A live alternative is that self-forgetting means only neglect of one's interests or accountability, not disrupted self-coherence.

changed_reading.before: Exclusive divinity demands correct outward allegiance.
changed_reading.after: Exclusive divinity also functions as an orienting memory by which the self remains coherent and answerable to itself.

context_deltas.mechanism: A raised, solid aggregate is imagined lowering itself and splitting under awe, with the result directed toward reflection. This revises al-Aziz, al-Jabbar, and al-Mutakabbir: true cohesion and grandeur do not merely out-harden rivals; they expose borrowed hardness, make it yield, and open a fissure through which thought can begin.

activation_trace.role: A high solid aggregate supplies the strongest created image of mass, elevation, and cohesion.
Lowering and submission reverse the mountain's elevated posture.
A fissure opening in something hard supplies the material transformation of apparent integrity.
Fear joined to awe supplies the directional pressure that produces lowering and fracture.
The heart's repeated movement around a matter supplies the cognitive opening sought by the material fracture.
Hard cohesion anchors the mountain's apparent rival property in the focus's al-Aziz.
Overpowering force anchors the capacity that makes even hard elevation yield.
Rightful grandeur supplies the true elevation before which created height lowers itself.

structural_cues: 59:21 places the mountain's lowering and cracking immediately before the three-ayah divine-name sequence.
The parable's stated human endpoint is reflection, not material ruin for its own sake.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies solid height, lowering, fracture, awe, and reflection; I infer that this sequence gives the following might titles a revelatory function that opens hardened perception. A live alternative is that the mountain image concerns reception of the Qur'an only and should not be transferred to the names.

changed_reading.before: Divine might and grandeur are maximal hardness and elevation.
changed_reading.after: They are the reality before which created hardness lowers and opens, converting fracture into the possibility of thought.

context_deltas.mechanism: The immediately preceding self-identification gives the scope and tone of al-Muhaymin: knowledge crosses what is hidden from eyes and what is present to witness, while the same sentence culminates in doubled mercy. Oversight is therefore comprehensive without being reducible to policing; its surveillance branch is held inside care.

activation_trace.role: Disclosure of a thing to the knower supplies the comprehensive cognitive scope of oversight.
What is screened from eyes supplies the domain no external observer can reach.
Presence with observation supplies the complementary visible and witnessed domain.
Mercy and tenderness supply the affective and purposive frame for total knowledge.
Witnessing, guarding, and standing over a thing anchor the revised oversight model in al-Muhaymin.

structural_cues: 59:22 and 59:23 begin with the same exclusive self-identification, so the knowledge-and-mercy clause directly precedes the longer title chain.
Hidden and witnessed form a scope pair before the paired mercy names.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies total hidden/visible knowledge, adjacent mercy, and the focus's guardian-witness branch; I infer that adjacency qualifies the manner and purpose of oversight. A live alternative is that the names remain parallel predicates and mercy does not specifically govern al-Muhaymin.

changed_reading.before: Al-Muhaymin suggests comprehensive surveillance and control.
changed_reading.after: Al-Muhaymin is comprehensive oversight across hidden and visible reality, explicitly approached through the adjacent field of mercy and care.

context_deltas.mechanism: The following verse unfolds agency as measuring, originating, bringing forth, shaping, beauty, and exact construction. This redirects al-Jabbar and al-Mutakabbir away from sheer domination: irresistible power and rightful greatness are also productive capacities that give differentiated things proportionate form.

activation_trace.role: Measuring and proportioning supply a precise design phase for constructive power.
Original bringing-into-being supplies the productive act that follows measure.
Creation and origination supply emergence as an alternative expression of irresistible agency.
Image and fashioned configuration supply differentiation rather than undirected force.
Beauty opposed to ugliness supplies an evaluative outcome for proportioned forms and names.
Exact, firm construction supplies the closure that makes creative force controlled and finished.
Repairing deficiency anchors constructive agency in the reparative branch of al-Jabbar.
Rightful greatness is revised as the scale capable of originating and proportioning without rivalry.

structural_cues: 59:24 immediately continues the repeated 'He is Allah' construction with three consecutive agent titles of creation and form.
Beautiful names and the final wise title follow the creator-originator-fashioner sequence.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies measure, origination, form, beauty, and exactness after the focus's force titles; I infer that the continuation discloses a constructive direction for might and grandeur. A live alternative is that 59:24 adds separate creative names without revising al-Jabbar or al-Mutakabbir.

changed_reading.before: Al-Jabbar and al-Mutakabbir primarily describe force above resistance.
changed_reading.after: Their irresistible scale is also constructive: it measures, brings forth, differentiates, and perfects forms rather than merely overpowering them.

context_deltas.mechanism: Past-tense cosmic tasbih opens the surah, the focus compresses tasbih into the nominal Subhan Allah, and present-tense cosmic tasbih closes it. The focus exclamation thus becomes the still center of an all-creation, cross-temporal practice of clearing God from association.

activation_trace.role: Tasbih as worship supplies the completed opening response of everything in the heavens and earth.
Exoneration and distancing from defect supply the semantic center compressed into Subhan Allah.
Tasbih as worship supplies the ongoing closing response of the same cosmic totality.

structural_cues: 59:1 uses a completed tasbih verb, 59:23 uses the verbal noun Subhan, and 59:24 uses an ongoing tasbih verb.
The same heavens-and-earth totality frames the surah at 59:1 and 59:24.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies repeated root, changing verbal form, and the same cosmic subject; I infer a temporal frame in which the focus noun condenses the surrounding action. A live alternative is that the forms vary stylistically and do not encode a staged temporal mechanism.

changed_reading.before: Subhan Allah is a local exclamation appended to the title list.
changed_reading.after: It is the concentrated center of the cosmos's completed and ongoing practice of clearing the divine names from every association.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: The hunter's snare is branch-distant from the direct theological sense of yushrikun, so this cannot replace 'associate partners.' It remains anchored in the focus root and gains contextual traction from alliances that entice through false promises and end in disavowal. Downstream prose should present it only as an exploratory material analogy for self-entangling reliance on partner-protections.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The final yushrikun carries a packet branch for the hunter's snare alongside partnership and association.

activation_trace.role: A hunter's entangling snare supplies the material image by which false partnership becomes capture.
Falsehood supplies the bait-like promise on which the partnership depends.
Disavowal supplies the moment when the apparent protector withdraws after entanglement.

changed_reading.before: Association is the assignment of a divine share to another claimant.
changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, association is also a protection arrangement that catches its participant: the partner attracts reliance, then abandons the reliant party inside the trap.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: Swimming or running is a physical branch distant from the direct devotional force of tasbih. It remains anchored in the repeated s-b-h root and is activated by the heavens-and-earth subject moving through opening, focus, and close. Downstream prose should qualify it as a kinetic image of ceaseless exoneration, not as a lexical substitution or cosmological claim.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: Subhan in 59:23 shares the packet's running-and-swimming branch with the tasbih verbs that frame the surah.

activation_trace.role: Running or swimming supplies a kinetic opening image for creation's completed tasbih.
The same motion branch makes the focus noun a concentrated passage rather than a static label.
Ongoing running or swimming carries the kinetic image beyond the focus into the closing present.

changed_reading.before: Tasbih is a stationary utterance of transcendence.
changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, tasbih is unbounded motion by which the whole created field continually carries the names away from every imposed likeness or partnership.

strongest_changes: The title list became an indivisible governance-and-repair architecture rather than a row of independent honorifics.
Fortresses, walls, fearful hearts, and scattered hearts relocated real security from external enclosure to inward coherence under al-Mu'min and al-Muhaymin.
Return, circulation, scarcity, other-preference, and removal of rancor made kingship and j-b-r repair materially redistributive.
False promises, retreat, and disavowal sharpened divine security into a witnessed guarantee that does not abandon dependence.
The mountain and the creator-originator-fashioner sequence redirected might from sheer hardness toward humbling, opening, measuring, and constructive form.
summary.what_was_special: The most productive activation was the coexistence of severe and reparative power: the context neither dissolves al-Jabbar into gentleness nor leaves it as brute compulsion, but repeatedly routes force through wisdom, calibrated preservation, redistribution, inward security, reflection, mercy, and formation.
remaining_uncertainties: The ordered titles may be appositional rather than a strict causal sequence, so functional arrows between adjacent names remain reader-supplied.
The degree to which neighboring ayat semantically qualify individual titles, rather than only framing the passage, remains open.
The snare and swimming branches are deliberately contained cross-domain images and should not be promoted to primary lexical meanings.
